import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import io

data = """
Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Load data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Convert Blood Pressure to numeric values
df['Blood Pressure'] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/').str[0].astype(int)

# Create a bar chart for Physical Activity Level
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(x='Occupation', y='Physical Activity Level', data=df)
